NEW Report: Significant Activity Identified at Minzadayi, an Iranian Nuclear Weapons Development Site High resolution @vantortech satellite imagery from September and October 2026 shows significant renewed activity at Minzadayi, a nuclear weapons development compound northeast of Tehran revealed by Israel during the 2026 war. The compound was attacked by Israel on March 3rd, 2026, destroying several buildings and likely underground structures. The recent satellite imagery indicates a return to regular vehicle activity around the site post extensive cleanup operation that included the clearing of rubble and debris and repair of damage on the hillside. One area attacked in March 2026 shows ongoing earth moving activity. The earth moving activity is occurring at a surface made to look like a courtyard where multiple craters could be seen following the attacks on the site in March 2026. Significant vehicle presence can be seen throughout the site between early September and early October 2026. Cars are parked outside the security perimeter in the parking lot, and many passenger vehicles and trucks can be seen inside the perimeter. Given what is known about this compound, this activity may be indicative of an effort by Iran to reestablish a nuclear weapons development capability and to reconstitute what was lost in the attack on the compound. Based on public reporting and statements released by the IDF, the nuclear weapons work carried out here likely involved research and development on nuclear warheads. The IDF originally stated, that a “group of nuclear scientists operated covertly to develop a key component in the nuclear weapons system,” adding that “the complex is designed to enable the restoration of the required technology and the advancement of capabilities for the development of nuclear weapons.” @IntelliTimes, released additional information on the compound. In a post from September 24, 2026, it states that the nuclear weapons related infrastructure was established in 2022 and “absorbed part of the means from the nuclear warehouse,” a common reference to the Turquz Abad site revealed by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in September 2018. Netanyahu revealed the site following Iran’s removal of more than a dozen shipping containers from the site that were assessed to hold nuclear material and equipment relevant to Iran’s nuclear weapons capabilities.[4] When the IAEA visited Turquz Abad in March 2019, it found evidence that nuclear material or contaminated equipment had been present at the site and the IAEA Board has since been pressing Iran to answer the IAEA’s questions about the current whereabouts of said material and/or equipment. @IntelliTimes indicates Iran did not simply move the material and/or equipment to a new long term storage site but used the new site in northeast Tehran, aka Minzadayi, to establish an” industrial nuclear headquarters for the reconstruction of research, development, and adaptation infrastructure for nuclear warheads,” including the means to “produce cores of enriched uranium and the explosive material required to cast into them the detonation chain.”[5] The current renewed effort underway at this highly secure compound suggests that the work being conducted here is of top priority. Seven candidates are vying to succeed António Guterres as the United Nations' tenth leader since 1946. The winner will become the United Nations' tenth secretary-general and will take office on January 1, 2027. This year's secretary-general selection could be of particular significance because the UN may choose its first-ever woman leader. There is also a strong possibility that a candidate from the Latin American and Caribbean region will be selected. Regardless of who takes the helm of the UN come January, experts agree they will be responsible for steering the 81-year-old organization through multiple critical challenges, including internal reforms, severe funding shortfalls, worsening climate change, the proliferation of AI, and escalating geopolitical tensions. Read more on who the candidates are, how are they selected, and what challenges will they face in the role: cfr.org/articles/who-will-be…

In a recent article for @NextBillion, Laxmi Sharma and Subhodeep Basu from ICRIER draw lessons from Rajasthan’s first farmer-owned Agri-PV pilot under PM-KUSUM-A, asking whether India can expand solar power without leaving farmers behind. The article tells the story of Kajod Mal, a farmer from Kundanpura, whose ground-mounted solar plant had significantly increased his income, but also taken his fertile agricultural land out of cultivation. Through ICRIER’s intervention, the plant was retrofitted into an elevated Agri-PV system, allowing Kajod to reclaim his farmland and grow maize and chillies beneath the solar panels, while continuing to earn from solar power. His potential income could now reach around ₹4.5 lakh per acre. According to them, the biggest challenge was building the farmer’s trust in an entirely new idea and demonstrating that solar and farming could work together. At its core, Agri-PV is about ensuring that farmers do not have to choose between farming and solar, but can retain their land, continue growing food and benefit from the energy transition at the same time. One in every two girls in Afghanistan were married before the age of 18, with child marriage continuing to threaten girls’ education, health and future opportunities, the United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Sunday, marking the International Day of the Girl Child. According to UNICEF, 28.7 percent of women aged 20 to 24 in Afghanistan were married before turning 18, based on the Afghanistan Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) 2022–2023. In some parts of the country, the rate reaches one in every two girls, the agency said. Read more: kabulnow.com/?p=56268

The United Nations and former Afghan President Hamid Karzai have called for renewed efforts to protect girls’ rights in Afghanistan, as millions remain excluded from education under restrictions imposed by the Taliban authorities. Marking the International Day of the Girl Child on Sunday, October 11, the United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) said millions of Afghan girls continued to face challenges including poverty, early marriage, limited access to education and illiteracy. M., director del portal de noticias “Pinotepa Comunica”. Vecinos de la zona alertaron a los números de emergencia tras escuchar intensas ráfagas de armas de fuego. Al arribar al lugar, elementos de corporaciones de seguridad solo confirmaron el deceso de dos personas, entre ellas el periodista, mientras que una mujer resultó gravemente herida durante la agresión. Apenas el pasado 16 de marzo, la región sufrió otro golpe con el atentado a balazos contra el reportero Óscar Merino Ruiz, director del portal informativo OM Noticias. La Fiscalía General del Estado de Oaxaca (FGEO) acordonó la escena del crimen para iniciar con las diligencias periciales correspondientes.

De laatste dagen zijn er mensen uit de moslimgemeenschap, zoals Mohammed, Ahmed, Salma, Hadricia of anderen, die mij op mijn sociale media voortdurend aanvallen en belachelijk proberen te maken omdat ik mij kritisch uitlaat over de rellen en vernielingen die door veel jonge allochtonen worden veroorzaakt in Brussel, Parijs en andere Europese steden. Ze zeggen daarbij: “Maar jij bent zelf ook een allochtoon.” Inderdaad. Ik ben van buitenlandse afkomst. En precies daarom wil ik heel duidelijk uitleggen waar het verschil ligt. Ik heb nooit tegen de westerse waarden gestreden. Integendeel. Ik verdedig ze met hart en ziel. Niet alleen uit respect voor de mensen en de samenleving die mij hebben ontvangen, iets wat eigenlijk iedereen zou moeten voelen, maar ook omdat ik zelf volledig achter die waarden en manier van leven sta en ze wil beschermen. Mijn kritiek gaat over de mensen die deze waarden verwerpen, die het Westen als verderfelijk beschouwen en die menen dat ze het uiteindelijk moeten vernietigen. Dat is waar ik mij tegen verzet. Helaas gaat het daarbij vaak om mensen uit de moslimgemeenschap. En wie naar de beelden van de vernielingen in Brussel, Parijs en andere Europese steden kijkt, ziet dat je onder de mensen die deze vernielingen veroorzaken bijna nooit een Pers uit Iran of een Jood tegenkomt. De mensen die publieke eigendommen vernielen, schade veroorzaken en proberen de samenleving te ontwrichten, komen vaak uit milieus waarin een sterke afkeer van het Westen en zijn waarden aanwezig is. Daar ligt mijn kritiek. Dus aan Said, Ahmed, Mohammed, Haticha of wie dan ook die probeert mij te kleineren, heb ik één boodschap: zet je energie niet op mij. Ik ben een zelfverzekerde vrouw die in de gevangenis van de ayatollahs rechtop bleef staan en nooit plooit. Jullie ‘intimidatie’ werkt niet op mij. Als volksvertegenwoordiger van dit prachtige land zal ik altijd problemen bij naam noemen om er vervolgens een oplossing voor te vinden. Als je werkelijk iets wilt veranderen, ga dan naar je eigen mensen, naar mensen van jouw generatie en binnen jouw eigen moslimgemeenschap, en spreek hen aan. Zeg hun dat het aanvallen van dit land, het vernielen van onze publieke ruimte en het veroorzaken van schade onaanvaardbaar is en moet stoppen. Ik heb niemand gevraagd om mij te volgen of het met mijn mening eens te zijn. Maar wie ervoor kiest om mij op mijn sociale media te volgen, zal mijn mening ook moeten kunnen verdragen. Je mag mij inhoudelijk bekritiseren en mij tegenspreken. Maar persoonlijke aanvallen en pogingen om mij belachelijk te maken, zijn niet nodig. Ik ben zelf een allochtoon. Het verschil is dat ik nooit tegen de samenleving die mij heeft ontvangen, heb gevochten. Ik heb ervoor gekozen haar waarden met hart en ziel te dragen en te verdedigen, en dat doe ik elke dag in mijn politieke engagement. Want ik hou van de westerse beschaving en ik hoop dat het hele Midden-Oosten ooit deze waarden zal dragen.

Bangladesh and IFAD are strengthening their long-standing partnership with US$324 million in new investments to build climate-resilient rural communities, improve livelihoods and support more sustainable food systems. The two projects, expected to reach an estimated 2.5 million rural people, will improve rural infrastructure and access to climate information, finance, skills and markets, while creating new opportunities for women, young people and rural entrepreneurs. “These two projects reflect a shared commitment to support rural communities to adapt and prosper in a changing climate,” said Valantine Achancho, IFAD Country Director and Representative in Bangladesh. The investments include the Climate Resilience and Livelihood Enhancement Project (CRALEP), supported by the Government of Denmark, and the Growth for Climate Resilient and Environmental Entrepreneurship and Nutrition (GREEN) project. Together, they aim to strengthen communities’ ability to withstand climate shocks while expanding economic opportunities and improving access to nutritious food. Since 1978, IFAD and Bangladesh have partnered on 39 projects representing approximately US$4.9 billion in total investment, reaching 11.7 million rural households and supporting small-scale agriculture, rural finance and value chain development. Read more at ifad.org/en/w/news/banglades… #FinancingTheFirstMile

Across my visit to India, I have seen how different parts of a rural economy reinforce each other through @IFAD's Meghalaya Livelihoods and Access to Markets Investment. At Umwang, the foundation is strong community institutions and shared services through a community-led aggregation facility, collective marketing and affordable farm mechanization for regional crops like pineapple, ginger and bay leaves. . At Bhoirymbong, it is community-led quality processing, value addition, and market linkages to higher-value regional and international markets. And here in Jirang, it is diversified, commercially viable agriculture and processing, with a 100-acre model farm bringing together farmers from the community showcasing 18 high-value crops. Rural transformation does not come from one intervention alone. It comes from connecting institutions, production, processing, finance and markets so that rural businesses can grow and communities can retain more value locally. That is the model we want to deepen and take to scale. #FinancingTheFirstMile

Pakistan’s federal government has declared a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, escalating a political dispute with the opposition-led provincial government as security tensions along the Afghanistan-Pakistan border continue. The announcement came as Pakistan’s military said 12 members of the Pakistani Taliban and Taliban forces in Afghanistan had been killed in a border clash. According to Pakistan’s Dawn newspaper, the federal cabinet approved the emergency on Sunday, October 11, before President Asif Ali Zardari endorsed the decision. The presidential office said the measure was taken under Articles 232 and 234 of Pakistan’s Constitution, which provide for emergency powers under specified circumstances. राष्ट्रऋषि, प्रखर चिंतक, समाज सुधारक एवं ग्रामोदय के पुरोधा भारत रत्न नानाजी देशमुख की जयंती पर उन्हें सादर नमन। उनका संपूर्ण जीवन त्याग, सेवा और निष्काम कर्मयोग का आदर्श उदाहरण है। उन्होंने अपने जीवन की पूरी पूँजी, ऊर्जा और अपना समय ग्राम विकास, ग्राम स्वराज और अंत्योदय के लिए समर्पित कर दिया। मानवता के प्रति उनका समर्पण और राष्ट्र निर्माण में उनका अतुलनीय योगदान सदैव आने वाली पीढ़ियों को प्रेरित करता रहेगा।

लोकनायक जयप्रकाश नारायण जी की जयंती पर उन्हें सादर नमन। उनका जीवन लोकतांत्रिक मूल्यों और राष्ट्रहित के प्रति अटूट प्रतिबद्धता का प्रतीक है। ‘संपूर्ण क्रांति’ का उनका आह्वान राजनीति में शुचिता, शासन में जवाबदेही और समाज में नैतिक पुनर्जागरण का संकल्प था। आपातकाल के काले अध्याय में उन्होंने अदम्य साहस के साथ तानाशाही का विरोध किया। संविधान, नागरिक स्वतंत्रता और लोकतांत्रिक अधिकारों की रक्षा के लिए उनका संघर्ष भारतीय इतिहास में सदैव स्मरणीय रहेगा। लोकनायक का जीवन हमें याद दिलाता है कि सत्ता से बड़ा सिद्धांत और व्यक्तिगत हित से बड़ा राष्ट्रहित होता है।

आप सभी को शारदीय नवरात्रि के पावन पर्व की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएँ। नवरात्रि के प्रथम दिवस पर माँ शैलपुत्री के श्रीचरणों में कोटि-कोटि नमन और वंदन। माँ का दिव्य स्वरूप हमें प्रकृति के प्रति श्रद्धा, जीवन में दृढ़ता और प्रत्येक परिस्थिति में अडिग रहने की प्रेरणा देता है। आदिशक्ति माँ शैलपुत्री सभी के जीवन में सुख, शांति और समृद्धि का संचार करें। वन्दे वाञ्छितलाभाय चन्द्रार्धकृतशेखराम्‌। वृषारूढां शूलधरां शैलपुत्रीं यशस्विनीम्‌ ।।

चुनाव आयोग एक संवैधानिक संस्था है। यह स्वतंत्र संस्था है और इसे स्वतंत्र रूप से निर्णय लेने का अधिकार है। लेकिन उन्हें स्वतंत्र रूप से निर्णय लेने नहीं दिया जा रहा है। चुनाव आयोग के दो सदस्यों ने खुलकर उजागर किया है कि आयोग किस तरह काम कर रहा है, उसमें किस प्रकार की अनियमितताएँ हो रही हैं और आयोग के सदस्य स्वयं इस स्थिति को लेकर क्या महसूस कर रहे हैं। इसके बावजूद इस मामले में कोई कार्रवाई नहीं की गई। यह सब इसलिए हो रहा है क्योंकि वे चाहते हैं कि वोट चोरी जारी रहे। अब तक जितनी भी वोट चोरी की गई है, उसी के बल पर केंद्र और राज्यों में सरकारें बनाई गई हैं। ऐसा माहौल तैयार करने के लिए मोदी जी ने 2023 में एक कानून बनाया, जिसके माध्यम से मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त और चुनाव आयुक्तों को कानूनी संरक्षण दिया गया। उन्हें ऐसी छूट दी गई, जो भारत के राष्ट्रपति या देश के मुख्य न्यायाधीश को भी प्राप्त नहीं है। लेकिन एक चुनाव आयुक्त को यह विशेष संरक्षण क्यों दिया गया? यह संरक्षण देने के बाद वोट चोरी, EVM और चुनावी घपले की यह पूरी प्रक्रिया शुरू की गई। CEC चाहे कितनी भी गलतियाँ करें, उन्हें जीवनभर उन गलतियों के लिए जवाबदेही से छूट दे दी गई है। इसका सीधा अर्थ है कि यह जनता के वोट छीनने और लोकतंत्र के साथ धोखाधड़ी करने की एक साजिश है। यही सब किया जा रहा है और हम इसके खिलाफ अपनी लड़ाई जारी रखेंगे। 📍बेंगलुरु, कर्नाटक Video

As our Cambodian friends celebrate the Pchum Ben, families make their way to pagodas with food, prayers and offerings to honour their departed ancestors. Among the foods prepared for the occasion is Bay Ben—small balls of sticky rice. Some are offered at the pagoda, while others are traditionally scattered around the temple grounds or nearby fields. The practice is connected to the belief that wandering or suffering spirits may be unable to enter sacred places. By leaving Bay Ben outside, families ensure that these spirits are not left without food as they remember those who have passed before them. It is one of the traditions that marks Pchum Ben, bringing together remembrance, family and Buddhist practice in Cambodia.

Old and busted: the German word, schadenfreude. New hottness: Polish word zakłamanie: society so saturated with lies that the truth becomes almost inaccessible. Brivael Le Pogam (@brivael) À chaque fois que je parle avec des Français, c'est la même chose. Ils sont désespérés. La dette, l'insécurité, l'islamisme, l'école, la natalité, le déclassement. « C'est foutu. » « La France est finie. » « On ne peut plus rien faire. » Moi, je suis ultra optimiste. Vraiment. Et voici pourquoi. D'abord parce qu'on a enfin mis un nom sur la maladie. @Kristof_Poland l'explique mieux que personne : le communisme n'a jamais été d'abord un système économique. C'était un système de mensonge institutionnalisé. Les Polonais ont même un mot pour ça, qu'on n'a pas en français : zakłamanie. Une société tellement saturée de mensonges que la vérité en devient presque inaccessible. Relisez ça et regardez la France. Soixante-dix ans de communisme mental. Pas de goulag, pas de chars, mais le même logiciel : le réel est négociable, les mots servent à masquer, et celui qui nomme les choses devient plus dangereux que les choses elles-mêmes. Résultat : une dette au-delà de 115 % du PIB qu'on appelle « modèle social ». Un islamisme qui progresse pendant qu'on vous traite de facho pour l'avoir remarqué. Une économie qui ne produit plus. Une jeunesse qui a honte de son pays. Une joie qui a disparu. Les Français pessimistes voient ces symptômes et pensent que c'est la fin. Moi je vois un diagnostic. Et un diagnostic, c'est le début de la guérison. Ensuite parce que le mensonge a une date de péremption. Un mensonge, ça coûte cher à entretenir. Il faut des subventions, des taxes, de la dette, des médias sous perfusion, des institutions qui tiennent la ligne. Et à un moment, il n'y a plus d'argent pour payer. C'est exactement là qu'on arrive. Ce que les pessimistes prennent pour un effondrement, c'est la fin du mensonge. Ensuite parce qu'on a la preuve que ça marche. La Pologne. Rayée de la carte pendant 123 ans. Écrasée par le nazisme puis par le communisme. Exsangue en 1989. Trente-cinq ans plus tard : l'une des plus fortes croissances d'Europe, seul pays de l'UE sans récession en 2009, une dette sous les 60 %, près de 5 % du PIB dans sa défense, des villes sûres, une identité intacte. Les Polonais ont vécu le mensonge total et ils en sont sortis. Ils ont des anticorps qu'on n'a pas encore. La Pologne n'est pas en retard sur l'Occident. Elle est en avance. C'est notre futur. Ensuite parce que la recette est connue. Bukele a montré qu'on peut rendre la sécurité à un pays en quelques années. Milei a montré qu'on peut casser l'inflation et l'État obèse plus vite que tous les experts ne le jugeaient possible. L'ordre et la liberté. Ce qu'on nous a vendu comme contradictoire, c'est en réalité la condition de toute civilisation. Et enfin parce que je sais ce qui vient après. Une renaissance économique : on reconstruit, on produit, on ose. Une renaissance de la joie : on refait des enfants, on refait des cathédrales, on refait la fête sans s'excuser. Une renaissance de nos valeurs : la raison, la liberté, la responsabilité, la beauté. Et un pacte clair avec ceux qui veulent venir. Bienvenue à ceux qui veulent devenir des nôtres. Mais devenir des nôtres, ça veut dire quelque chose : la langue, les lois, les mœurs, l'histoire. On s'assimile ou on repart. C'est ce que la France a toujours fait avec ceux qui l'ont aimée, et c'est la plus grande marque de respect : les traiter en égaux, pas en clientèle. Alors non, la France n'est pas finie. Elle sort d'une anesthésie de soixante-dix ans. Le réveil fait mal, mais c'est un réveil. Les pessimistes regardent les ruines. Moi je regarde Varsovie. Et je vois l'âge d'or qui arrive. 🇵🇱🇫🇷 — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/brivael/status/2108887940529049733#m

Trump Gives Green Light to Saudi Nuclear Program The Donald Trump administration has finalized the draft of a bilateral nuclear agreement that authorizes Saudi Arabia to enrich uranium on its own territory. Although the negotiating teams have completed the terms, the document still awaits Trump’s final signature and approval by the U.S. Congress. This framework breaks with the region’s long-standing non-proliferation rules. Unlike the deal with the United Arab Emirates, which permanently renounced uranium enrichment and plutonium reprocessing while accepting strict IAEA inspections, the agreement with the Saudis does not require Riyadh to adopt the Agency’s inspection regime. Oversight will be limited to a bilateral pact between the United States and Saudi Arabia. This reinforces what Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has already said openly: if Iran gets a nuclear weapon, Saudi Arabia will want one too. It sounds like a clear signal that Riyadh believes Tehran already has, or is very close to having, the bomb, which explains the intense pressure they are putting on Washington. The situation puts the U.S. in a complicated position. Saudi Arabia’s ballistic missile program is developed in partnership with China, complete with technology transfers. If the Americans don’t give in now, the Saudis have plenty of money to look for other partners. This is not just about civilian nuclear energy. For that, it would be enough to buy reactors and import ready-made fuel. What Riyadh really wants is to master the full nuclear fuel cycle, especially domestic uranium enrichment. With this infrastructure, Saudi Arabia is building a nuclear latency capability: it will control the core technology needed to develop a weapon in relatively short order if pushed by an existential threat. At first, I was shocked to learn Texas was importing English Teachers from India, but what I’ve just learned is even worse. TEXAS TAXPAYERS ARE PAYING MILLIONS TO AN EDUCATION COMPANY DEVELOPING AMERICAN SCHOOL CURRICULUM IN INDIA. And the deeper I dig, the worse this looks. Imagine Learning says it serves 18 MILLION students, 38,000+ U.S. schools and HALF of all American school districts. I’ve identified more than $7.7 MILLION in Texas district contracts, purchasing authorizations and payment records. Imagine Learning is recruiting workers in Bengaluru to develop American K–12 curriculum. Not just software engineers, not customer support but CURRICULUM ARCHITECTS, INSTRUCTIONAL DESIGNERS, ENGLISH LANGUAGE ARTS MANAGERS. People in India are developing American K–12 reading lessons, writing assignments, literature questions, essay prompts, assessments and materials “aligned with U.S. state education standards.” They’re even recruiting managers to oversee curriculum design decisions and AI-assisted lesson development. We’re talking about the actual educational content being created for American children and this goes FAR beyond one office. INFOSYS publicly announced TWO AI-first delivery centers for Imagine Learning in Chandigarh and Pune, supporting product engineering, business systems and operations. Straive LearningMate also names Imagine Learning as a client for AI-assisted curriculum production, including assessments and content transformation. Its executives describe a relationship spanning more than a decade and the INDIAN GOVERNMENT is celebrating the expansion. Karnataka’s government technology department publicly promoted Imagine Learning’s Bengaluru operation, highlighting AI, data science, engineering and product development. Imagine Learning India executive Ravi Shanker also reported attending a Karnataka government-hosted industry meeting with senior political leadership. But wait, there’s more - look at what Imagine Learning markets to TEXAS schools: 7TH GRADE TEXAS HISTORY. 8TH GRADE U.S. HISTORY. AMERICAN GOVERNMENT. U.S. HISTORY SINCE 1877. ENGLISH LANGUAGE ARTS. A Houston charter school’s Texas Education Agency grant application specifically identified Imagine Learning for seventh-grade Texas History and eighth- and eleventh-grade U.S. History. We’re talking about lessons addressing Texas independence, annexation, the Constitution and the history of our country. WHO is writing those lessons? WHERE are they being developed? Who has final editorial authority? AND THEN THERE’S THE CHILDREN’S DATA. Imagine Learning’s privacy policy says its platforms can collect student names, assessments, writing samples, audio recordings, demographic information, and sensitive indicators including IEP status, foster care and homelessness. The company says personal information is stored and processed in the United States, but it’s also hiring platform and data engineers in India. Can employees or contractors overseas remotely access identifiable student records? Do Infosys or LearningMate personnel have access? What do the Texas contracts actually permit? We have outsourced American jobs, technology and entire industries. Now companies are building offshore operations around the development of lessons for American children - financed by American taxpayers. TEXAS NEEDS A FULL AUDIT OF IMAGINE LEARNING. Every taxpayer dollar, every offshore contractor, every curriculum author, every AI workflow and every very permission to access student data. American parents deserve to know who writes their children’s lessons and who can see their records. How many of you knew OUR children’s curriculum is being developed in India? I think I need to keep pulling this thread.

.@WHO's Disease Outbreak News on pneumonia of undetermined cause in the Russian Federation is out, detailing information available so far: nitter.perennialte.ch/WHO/status/21089520334… World Health Organization (WHO) (@WHO) 🟦 On 2 October 2026, WHO became aware through media reports of the death of an employee of the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East, the Russian Federation. 🟦 According to these reports, the individual died on 2 October following hospitalization for severe pneumonia on 29 September, and pneumonic plague was suspected as the cause of death, following occupational exposure in laboratory settings. 🟦 Following requests for verification from WHO, the National Focal Point for the International Health Regulations (2005) (NFP) of the Russian Federation confirmed the death and informed WHO that no case of plague had been registered recently in Irkutsk Oblast, that preventive and control measures had been implemented in accordance with national sanitary legislation, and that the laboratory testing of contacts detected no high-threat pathogens. 🟦 The authorities also reported that no biosecurity incidents had occurred in the laboratory, contrary to reports in the media, and that there were no further case of severe pneumonia linked to this case. 🟦 The NFP informed WHO that the case and all contacts had been tested for a range of microorganisms, including high-threat pathogens. Test results were negative for the tested high-threat pathogens. 🟦 All contacts had been medically followed up in healthcare facilities or at home, and all remained asymptomatic throughout. Quarantine measures were instituted in the hospital where the patient was being treated. 🟦 Based on the information provided by NFP, WHO has not identified evidence of ongoing transmission associated with this event. A key uncertainty remains the absence of a confirmed diagnosis in the deceased laboratory worker. 🟦 WHO will continue to monitor the situation and assess any potential public health implications as further information becomes available. Netanyahu supporters seem to be taking advantage of @Brett_McGurk’s book and interviews to claim vindication for Netanyahu’s conduct of the war in Gaza. But while Brett’s front-row account is valuable, that doesn’t mean it is definitive or its perspectives widely shared—including among former members of the Biden administration. I would say most of my former colleagues think that President Biden should have put more pressure on Israel to conduct the war differently and end it sooner, and few think that the biggest mistake Biden made was to show daylight with Israel. And even Brett’s account makes clear that hostages were not the top priority for Netanyahu and that when U.S. pressure actually was applied—as after the World Central Kitchen strike—it worked. Brett tells the story of the Biden phone call after that tragedy, but not the story of how Biden called Netanyahu on July 4, 2024 to press him to conclude the hostage deal after Hamas had finally accepted the basic framework, dropping its demand that Israel commit to a permanent ceasefire before any hostages were released. Netanyahu instead added so many of his own conditions—against the advice of his own security chiefs—that the deal became impossible for another six months, during which nearly 9,000 more Palestinians were killed and more Israeli hostages died, including the six that Hamas executed in August. The Israeli changes included a demand that Israel retain forces along Gaza’s entire border with Egypt, which the IDF had seized only after the original proposal, and a new enforcement mechanism to screen Gazans who were returning home to the north which would have required Israeli troops to remain in central Gaza. Both of those new conditions were dropped in the deal ultimately concluded in January 2025. Nothing in the book or elsewhere changes the reality that October 7 happened on Netanyahu’s watch; that he prioritized “total victory” and the maintenance of his coalition over a hostage deal or an end of the war; that his conduct of the war and management of its humanitarian consequences catastrophic; that it has left Israel more isolated and insecure; and that it has deeply damaged, perhaps irreparably, Israel’s relationship with the United States—which should have done more to change Israel’s conduct rather than enable it. There was never an easy way forward in Gaza, but no version of the story vindicates Netanyahu.

সংবাদ বিজ্ঞপ্তি বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী ও সেনাবাহিনী প্রধানকে জড়িয়ে বিভ্রান্তিকর তথ্য প্রচার প্রসঙ্গে ঢাকা, ১০ অক্টোবর ২০২৬ (শনিবার): সম্প্রতি লক্ষ্য করা যাচ্ছে যে, বিভিন্ন অনলাইন প্ল্যাটফর্ম ও সামাজিক যোগাযোগমাধ্যমে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী এবং সেনাবাহিনী প্রধানকে জড়িয়ে বিভ্রান্তিকর, ভিত্তিহীন ও উদ্দেশ্যপ্রণোদিত তথ্য প্রচার করা হচ্ছে। মূলত, এসকল তথ্যের মাধ্যমে জনমনে বিভ্রান্তি সৃষ্টি এবং বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর ভাবমূর্তি ক্ষুণ্ন করার অপচেষ্টা চালানো হচ্ছে বলে প্রতীয়মান হয়। এ ধরনের বিভ্রান্তিকর ও উদ্দেশ্যপ্রণোদিত অপপ্রচারে প্রভাবিত না হওয়ার জন্য সকলকে বিনীত অনুরোধ জানানো হচ্ছে। সুদৃঢ় চেইন অব কমান্ড, পারস্পরিক আস্থা, ঐক্য, শৃঙ্খলা ও পেশাদারিত্বের ভিত্তিতে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী সর্বদা ঐক্যবদ্ধ এবং দেশ ও জনগণের প্রতি অর্পিত দায়িত্ব পালনে দৃঢ়প্রতিজ্ঞ। বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনী ও সেনাবাহিনী প্রধান সম্পর্কিত যেকোনো তথ্যের ক্ষেত্রে আনুষ্ঠানিক ও নির্ভরযোগ্য তথ্যসূত্র অনুসরণ করার আহ্বান জানানো হচ্ছে।

A 17-year-old Afghan worker has died after falling from a building while working in Iran, local sources said. The teenager, identified as Mohammad Naser Dam, fell while working at a construction site on Thursday, October 8, and died, according to the sources. Dam was a resident of Jamshidi village in Pashtun Kot district of northern Faryab province. Sources said he had travelled to Iran to find work and help cover his family’s living expenses. An 18-year-old man has been stabbed to death in the Regration area of Dasht-e Barchi, in western Kabul, with a local resident suggesting robbery may have been the motive. The victim, identified as Ali Abbas Khanzada, was attacked at around 6 a.m. on Wednesday, October 7, in Jafariya Alley, First Street, in the Regration area, according to a resident who shared the information with KabulNow. He died from blood loss following the stabbing. Read more: kabulnow.com/?p=56252

The European Union has appointed Danish diplomat Thomas Frellesen as its new Special Envoy for Afghanistan, as the bloc continues its engagement with the country amid ongoing restrictions imposed by the Taliban on women and girls. Frellesen announced on Friday, October 9, that he had officially begun his role as the EU’s Special Envoy for Afghanistan. In a post on X, he said the Afghan people, particularly women and girls, would remain at the centre of the European Union’s engagement with Afghanistan. He also expressed his readiness to work with partners in the region and beyond. Read more: kabulnow.com/?p=56248

During Mazingira Day celebrations in Endebess, Trans Nzoia County, distributed cocoa seedlings to farmers, marking the beginning of growing the crop in Kenya. Our goal is to grow trees that protect the environment while generating income for farmers. Later, unveiled an aerial seeding technology to complement the tree-planting exercise and accelerate forest restoration. At the same time, launched the Mt Elgon Integrated Conservation and Livelihood Improvement Programme Strategic Plan 2026-2036 to restore degraded forests, protect water resources and improve livelihoods of communities around Mt Elgon.

Witnessed the second edition of ‘Exercise Tarang Shakti’ in Jodhpur today. There is considerable scope for cooperation in research, co-development, co-production, maintenance, training, and innovation. The defence relationships of the future will be about technology and trust, not just about platforms. India is ready to explore these possibilities with countries that share our commitment to a stable, secure, and peaceful international environment. We are aware that no nation can afford to operate in isolation. Critical technologies, resilient supply chains, operational inter-operability and trusted partnerships are becoming increasingly important elements of national power. For India, therefore, building strong indigenous capabilities must go hand in hand with meaningful cooperation with trusted partners. We must be capable of acting independently when required, while also being able to operate effectively with others when our interests and responsibilities converge. It is precisely in this context that an exercise like Tarang Shakti assumes special significance. It translates the broader ideas of capability, technology, interoperability and trust into operational experience. By bringing together air forces, with diverse platforms and philosophies, it enables aircrews and commanders to sense, decide, and act together across different languages of command. The canvas of Tarang Shakti extends well beyond flying operations. Industrial tours expose participating contingents to India’s expanding aerospace, defence manufacturing and technological ecosystem, while professional engagements promote the exchange of knowledge and experience.

I have to monitor them for my dogs, they go crazy with so many commercials. And now with a newborn, can definitely see the challenge in these other types of commercials too. Jimmy Spencer (@JimmySpencer) My 7-year-old son can’t watch sports with me anymore. Not because of the games, but because of the commercials. The horror movie trailers are the worst. The terrifying imagery can send him into a spiral of anxiety that lasts well beyond the 30-second ad. These are images his young mind simply isn’t ready to process. We talk a lot about mental health in this country, especially in sports. Yet between the relentless gambling ads, alcohol promotions and genuinely disturbing horror trailers, I’ve reached a point where watching an MLB or NFL game with my kids requires me to monitor every commercial break. I love sports. I work in sports. Some of my favorite childhood memories were made watching games with my family. I want that for my sons. I wish we could exercise better judgment about what we’re putting in front of families during sporting events. Sports should bring generations together. Instead, I’m increasingly forced to treat game day like an adults-only event. Something feels very wrong about that. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/JimmySpencer/status/2108282182267711972#m

आज महामहिम राष्ट्रपति महोदया ने INDI गठबंधन को मिलने का समय दिया था। राहुल गांधी और उनके नेतृत्व में इंडी गठबंधन के नेता, जो पिछले कई दिनों से अनर्गल, निराधार प्रदर्शन कर रहे हैं, उन्होंने देश के सर्वोच्च संस्थान (राष्ट्रपति एक व्यक्ति नहीं हैं, वो देश की सर्वोच्च संवैधानिक संस्था हैं) को लेकर ऐसा बयान दिया है, जो न सिर्फ विचित्र लगता है, बल्कि उसमें सच से ज्यादा सियासत की गंध आ रही है। उनका ये कहना कि महामहिम राष्ट्रपति महोदया ने उनके आरोपों को स्वीकार कर लिया है, ये दर्शाता है कि राहुल गांधी देश की हर संवैधानिक संस्था को अपनी राजनीति का शिकार बनाने का दुष्चक्र रच रहे हैं। उन्होंने आज सारी सीमाएं पार कर दी हैं। अंदर वास्तविकता में क्या बात हुई, ये तो वहां बैठा कोई व्यक्ति ही बता सकता है। परन्तु जिस समय राहुल गांधी ये बोल रहे थे, उनके साथ खड़े नेताओं की भाव-भंगिमा और उनके चेहरे के भाव ये साफ परिलक्षित कर रहे थे कि जो बोला जा रहा है, उसका सच से कोई सरोकार नहीं है। राहुल गांधी का पिछला ट्रैक रिकॉर्ड भी ये रहा है। वो देश के सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के बारे में झूठ बोलने के लिए बिना शर्त माफी मांग चुके हैं। इसके बाद, देश के मुख्य चुनाव आयोग पर वो निरंतर बिना किसी आधार के आरोप लगाते जा रहे हैं। आज राष्ट्रपति के साथ हुई वार्ता को इस रूप में प्रस्तुत किया, जैसे वह उनकी सियासत को सूट करता है। ये बहुत ही दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण है। - डॉ. @SudhanshuTrived Video

आज उपचुनाव हुए हैं। मैं कांग्रेस से पूछना चाहता हूं, इन उपचुनाव में जो इलेक्टोरल रोल बने थे, आपके BLA ने उसे चेक किया था या नहीं? कोई शिकायत दर्ज की थी या नहीं? जब चुनाव हुआ तो आपके इलेक्शन एजेंट वहां थे या नहीं? इलेक्शन एजेंट ने एक-एक चीज चेक की या नहीं? जब काउंटिंग हुई, तो आपके काउंटिंग एजेंट वहां थे या नहीं? एक-एक चीज CCTV के अंदर थी या नहीं? और फिर भी आप चुनाव हारे हैं। आपको शर्म आनी चाहिए। अभी 45 दिन का समय है, आप अभी CCTV फुटेज मांगेंगे या नहीं? या बाद में कहेंगे कि 45 दिन का समय निकल गया था? आज जो उपचुनाव परिणाम आए हैं, मतगणना से पहले, नामांकन से पहले तक मतदाता सूची में संशोधन किया जा सकता है। आपके BLA ने क्या कोई गलती पाई और अगर पाई, तो क्या किसी संशोधन के लिए एप्लीकेशन दी या नहीं दी? मतदान और मतगणना के दौरान आपके इलेक्शन एजेंट ने क्या सारी चीजों को देखा या नहीं? अगर कोई चीज आपत्तिजनक लगी, तो आपने आपत्ति जताई या नहीं? असम के सिलचर नगर निगम में बैलेट से भी चुनाव हुए, लेकिन उसमें भी आपका बाजा बज गया। 42 में से 34 सीटें भाजपा-एनडीए को मिलीं। इसके बाद भी क्या कुछ कहने लायक बचता है? मैं राहुल गांधी से पूछना चाहता हूं कि आप 2 साल पहले हल्ला मचाते थे कि EVM हैक है, अब हल्ला मचा रहे हैं कि SIR गलत है। आप तब सच बोल रहे थे या आज सच बोल रहे हैं? हकीकत ये है कि आप तब भी झूठ बोल रहे थे और आज भी झूठ बोल रहे हैं। - डॉ. @SudhanshuTrived Video

A pleasure to address a distinguished gathering at the Adwa Memorial Museum, Addis Ababa. Spoke about the India - Africa Partnership, that is historic, based on shared solidarities and one which seeks fairness, representation, opportunity and the freedom to shape our own future. Highlighted : ➡️ How ‘Viksit Bharat by 2047’ and ‘Agenda 2063’ visions emphasise industrialisation. And that it must not be denied by flooding our markets with cheap goods or by restricting our market access. ➡️ Our robust trade and investment relationship, in manufacturing, telecommunications, pharmaceuticals, energy, mining, agriculture, infrastructure, financial services and information technology. ➡️ Our mutual conviction for self-reliance, a viable basis for the future of our enduring partnership. ➡️ Our Development partnership will respond to the priorities of our partners. India has supported more than 220 projects in power generation, electricity transmission, water, agriculture, railways, health, manufacturing and public infrastructure. ➡️ Our commitment to building capacities. In the last decade, more than 70,000 African students and professionals have been supported by India in this aspect. ➡️ The transformative impact of digital governance, as well as growing India stack cooperation with Africa. Space, Drone and AI are new frontiers of this cooperation. ➡️ Our efforts to promote Africa’s health security, including through Vaccine support, Pharmaceutical investments and gifting Bhabatron cancer machines. ➡️ The promise of deeper cooperation in agri productivity, climate-resilient practices, value-add and food processing. Partnerships of the future must help create capabilities, not dependencies. ➡️ Our deepening security & maritime cooperation as well as our India’s contribution of peacekeeping operations in Africa. ➡️ The importance of reformed multilateralism reflective of contemporary realities. The inclusion of AU in G20 during 🇮🇳’s presidency is a step-forward. ➡️ That Africa will remain among India’s highest priorities, as articulated by PM Modi in Kampala. Dr. S. The Nobel Prize (@NobelPrize) 2026 Nobel Peace Prize laureate Navi Pillay’s commitment to universal legal principles and her firm moral compass are constants in a long career. Born into a family of Indian Tamil origin under apartheid in Durban, South Africa, Pillay became a lawyer and legal pioneer, confronting deep structural discrimination, segregation and exclusion. A common thread runs from her early work defending Nelson Mandela and others who stood up against apartheid to her service as a judge in some of the key international court cases of our time. This year’s laureate has significantly enlarged the scope and impact of international law. She has served as a judge on the High Court in South Africa, the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda and the International Criminal Court. She was the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights and, until recently, she chaired the UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory. Today Navi Pillay is a judge on the International Court of Justice in the case where Myanmar stands accused of genocide. In historic international court cases, she has shown that legal measures can help prevent acts of war and violence. Navi Pillay has also contributed to strengthen the institutions of international law. Her independence, expertise and steadfastness have made her one of the most respected international jurists of our time. Повернення полеглих стало результатом спільної та скоординованої роботи Генерального штабу Збройних Сил України, Об’єднаного центру при Службі безпеки України, Секретаріату Уповноваженого з питань осіб, зниклих безвісти за особливих обставин, Координаційного штабу з питань поводження з військовополоненими, Державної служба України з надзвичайних ситуацій та інших складових сектору безпеки й оборони України. Сприяння також надає Міжнародний Комітет Червоного Хреста. Невід’ємною складовою цього процесу є робота пошукових груп Гуманітарного проєкту Збройних Сил України «НА ЩИТІ», діяльність яких координує Центральне управління цивільно-військового співробітництва Генерального штабу Збройних Сил України. Under the Philippines’ ASEAN Chairship, the 44th AMEM marked the substantial completion of the 2026 Priority Economic Deliverables (PEDs) for the energy sector, with key outcomes including: - Endorsement of the APGCC Task Force Workplans, supporting the continued development of the ASEAN Power Grid. - Acknowledgement of ongoing discussions on the ASEAN Submarine Power Cable Development Framework. - Launch of the 9th ASEAN Energy Outlook (AEO9). - Launch of the ASEAN School of Regulation (ASR). - Endorsement of key regional studies covering nuclear power financing and human resources development, CCUS, upstream oil and gas fiscal benchmarking, sustainable energy management certification, BESS, variable renewable energy integration, and cross-border renewable energy certificate (REC) markets. The Meeting extends its appreciation to the Government of the Philippines for its warm hospitality and excellent arrangements in hosting the 44th AMEM and its Associated Meetings. Photo credit: Department of Energy (DOE) Philippines

The 44th ASEAN Ministers on Energy Meeting (44th AMEM) and its associated meetings and events were successfully convened from 5–9 October 2026 in Pasay City, Metro Manila, Philippines, under the Chairship of H.E. Sharon S. Garin, Secretary of the Department of Energy of the Philippines, H.E. Tan See Leng, Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry (Energy and Industry) of Singapore as Vice Chair, and participation of H.E. Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, the Secretary General of ASEAN. Energy Ministers and senior officials from all ASEAN Member States participated, alongside representatives from ASEAN’s Dialogue Partners — Australia, China, India, Japan, New Zealand, the Republic of Korea, the Russian Federation, and the United States — as well as the ASEAN Secretariat and key ASEAN energy bodies and international organisations, including ACE, ASCOPE, HAPUA, ERIA, IEA, IRENA, ADB and WB. The 26th ASEAN Energy Business Forum (AEBF-26) and the ASEAN Energy Awards 2026 were also convened alongside the Meeting, providing platforms to strengthen collaboration among policymakers, industry, investors and other stakeholders, while recognising achievements in ASEAN’s energy sector. Photo credit: Department of Energy (DOE) Philippines

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today met with the Chargé d’Affaires of the Permanent Mission of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar to ASEAN, Mr. Mang Hau Thang, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. 1. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio delivered a speech from the birthplace of democracy. In Athens, he advocated for Trump’s policies, made the case for America First, urged Europe to awaken from slumber & attacked Iran’s ‘radical mullahs’. #CutTheClutter looks at the speech’s significance, its implications, & explains why it was a 2028 campaign speech disguised as statecraft. 2. Rubio’s central message to Europe was unmistakable. The West, he warned, must decide whether it intends to retain its place at the head of the world or resign itself to “servitude, atrophy and decline”. The other standout argument was that power is not simply about possessing capabilities. It is about convincing others that you are willing to use them. This applies to, for example, military force, trade leverage & tariffs. 3. There was also a defence of Trump’s transactional foreign policy. Rubio invoked Greenland, arguing that confrontation had eventually produced a settlement in which the US, Denmark & Greenland all emerged with gains. Rubio attacked Iran’s “radical mullahs”, portraying their ideology as one that glorifies death & martyrdom. He contrasted this with the Western ideal of heroes willing to die for a cause but not worshipping death itself. 4. Rubio’s speech was carefully constructed: The ancient setting, the references to Greek democracy & Rome, the invocation of Christianity, the language of duty & heroism. And that’s where 2028 enters the picture. Rubio has been a Republican presidential contender, & this certainly seemed to be a 2028 campaign speech wrapped in the very gentle language of diplomacy. 5. What does his speech mean for India? · Trumpism won’t disappear after Trump. If Republicans return, a Rubio- or Vance-led govt could preserve much of this agenda, albeit in a different tone. Even a Democratic administration may retain parts of these policies. · US focus on supply chains, re-industrialisation, military strength, tech dominance, AI, strategic autonomy, & critical minerals are not just Trump’s passing fancy, US policy will be built around them. India can live with this as long as it is seen an ally, friend or useful. · CNP or comprehensive national power. India needs to look at this. CNP is not just military strength, it’s also size of the economy, tech capability, industrial depth, critical-mineral security & quality of human resources. #CutTheClutter with me. How can local agro-processing create new market opportunities, improve rural incomes and strengthen livelihoods for small-scale farmers? In India's Meghalaya state, the Megh Farm Processing Hub demonstrates how local value addition can help pineapple farmers access wider markets, diversify income opportunities and strengthen rural livelihoods. Established by Muktidada Multi Purpose Cooperative Society, the Hub became fully operational in February 2024, creating a platform to transform locally grown produce into marketable products. A US$200,000 IFAD grant helped purchase machinery and equipment, including a cold storage facility that allows locally produced ice creams, juices, jams and other products to be stored before sale. By processing pineapples and other local produce into ice cream, juices, jams and other products, while also supplying pineapples to markets as far away as Abu Dhabi, the Hub is helping farmers capture greater value from their harvests. Farmers who previously earned just INR 2–3 in profit per pineapple can now earn up to INR 12, while the enterprise creates direct employment and generates indirect economic opportunities for thousands of others. Find out more at ifad.org/en/w/opinions/rural… #FinancingTheFirstMile Video

At the invitation of H.E. Mr. Sergey Lavrov, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Russian Federation, Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, will be undertaking a Working Visit to the Russian Federation, from 13 to 15 October 2026. The visit follows the successful convening of the ASEAN-Russia Commemorative Summit in Kazan, Russia, on 17-28 June 2026, and reflects the continued momentum in the ASEAN-Russia Strategic Partnership. During the visit, Dr. Kao is scheduled to meet with Ministers and representatives in charge of the three pillars of ASEAN Community and ASEAN Connectivity, as well as with the ASEAN Committee in Moscow. The visit will provide an opportunity to discuss ways to further deepen cooperation in areas of shared priority.

Deputy Secretary-General of ASEAN for ASEAN Political-Security Community, H.E. Dato' Astanah Abdul Aziz, called on the Minister for Foreign Affairs of Singapore, H.E. Dr. Vivian Balakrishnan, on 8 October 2026, during her visit to Singapore in preparation for Singapore’s ASEAN Chairmanship in 2027. Both sides exchanged views on Singapore's ASEAN Chairmanship priorities. DSG Dato' Astanah reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat's support for Singapore as the incoming ASEAN Chair.

The Deputy Secretary-General of ASEAN for ASEAN Political-Security Community (DSG APSC), H.E. Dato’ Astanah Abdul Aziz, undertook a consultative visit to Singapore on 7–8 October 2026 in preparation for Singapore’s ASEAN Chairmanship in 2027. During the visit, DSG Dato’ Astanah held consultations with Singapore’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ministry of Home Affairs and Ministry of Defence on Singapore’s priorities and proposed deliverables under the APSC Pillar. The discussions covered, among others, cooperation in addressing transnational crime, border management and immigration, illicit drugs, defence and security cooperation, ASEAN’s external relations, as well as preparations and coordination between Singapore and the ASEAN Secretariat ahead of the Chairmanship. The ASEAN Secretariat reaffirmed its readiness to support Singapore in the lead-up to and throughout its ASEAN Chairmanship in 2027. The visit also included luncheons hosted by H.E. Albert Chua, Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Singapore’s ASEAN SOM Leader, together with H.E. Foo Chi Hsia, Second Permanent Secretary (Development), Ministry of Foreign Affairs as well as by Mr. Harry Goh, Director-General of ASEAN-Singapore, Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 received H.E. Archbishop Paul Richard Gallagher, Secretary for Relations with States of the Holy See, at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The Archbishop is visiting Pakistan to mark the 75th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between Pakistan and the Holy See. The DPM/FM welcomed the Archbishop and acknowledged the Holy See’s role in promoting peace, interfaith harmony and dialogue, and appreciated the valuable contributions of Pakistan’s Catholic community, particularly in education and health. Archbishop Gallagher commended Pakistan’s constructive role in promoting regional peace and stability through mediation, dialogue and diplomacy. The DPM/FM appreciated Pope Leo XIV’s principled calls for peace and a just resolution of the Palestine conflict, reaffirmed Pakistan’s unwavering solidarity with the Palestinian people. They expressed deep concern over the continuing humanitarian crisis and emphasized the importance of sustained international efforts to advance peace in the region. Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to further strengthening Pakistan–Holy See relations and promoting mutual respect, understanding and peaceful coexistence among faiths.

Mr. Salman Sharif, Ambassador-designate of Pakistan to Germany, called on Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs today. The DPM/FM congratulated him on his appointment and underscored the importance of further deepening Pakistan–Germany relations, particularly by expanding economic cooperation and promoting trade and investment. He also emphasized that close engagement with the Pakistani diaspora in Germany, support for their welfare, and the provision of efficient consular services must remain key priorities for the Embassy. The DPM/FM appreciated Mr. Salman Sharif’s work in his last assignment as Joint Secretary in the Prime Minister’s Office and wished him every success in his new assignment.

With its strikes on Moscow, Ukraine is taking disruption to a new level. The success of a long-range strike is not measured by impact alone. Even an intercepted attack closes airspace, disrupts flights and logistics, and erodes the sense of security. Russia cannot protect everything. It has more targets than air defences. Hitting the target magnifies the effect, but disruption begins before destruction. Yes, Russia will continue firing ballistic missiles at Ukrainian cities. But Putin’s problem is that Ukrainian suffering will no longer compensate Russians for disruption at home. As that disruption spreads, Russians will increasingly blame Putin and his corrupt regime for breaking the central bargain underpinning his rule since 2022: war was supposed to be something Ukrainians suffer, not them. The choice is Putin’s: wind down the war to preserve control, or tighten control at home to keep the war going. I would love to be wrong, but everything we know about him suggests he will choose the latter.

IFAD has launched a new three-year project to strengthen the long-term resilience and livelihoods of 4,000 herding families in #Mongolia, helping them adapt to increasingly variable weather conditions while protecting their livestock and incomes. As Mongolia’s summers become drier and winters harsher, herding families are facing increasing pressure on their livelihoods. In response, the project will invest in practical solutions to help them manage climate risks, protect productive assets and improve market access. Funded by a US$2 million grant from the @adaptationfund, the project will be managed by IFAD in partnership with the Office of the President of Mongolia and @UNIDO. “This project offers life-changing support – water closer to the pastures, early warning before a hard winter arrives, and a better opportunity and place to sell what they produce – so families can build their resilience to extreme weather shocks and continue making a living from herding,” said Nii Quaye-Kumah, IFAD Country Director for Mongolia. Working in the two hardest-hit provinces, the project will build solar-powered water stations and small earth banks to capture and store rainwater, and establish flood-safe centres where herders can store, process and sell wool, hides and dairy products. Through field schools, the project will also train 4,000 herders – at least 40% of them women – in pasture and livestock management, and connect a national database to early warning systems. Last Friday, the 2nd of October, the first media reports emerged of a suspected case of pneumonic plague in a laboratory worker at the Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute in the Russian Federation. The lab worker died after being hospitalized with severe pneumonia. Initial media reports suggested pneumonic plague following an accidental lab exposure. @WHO is aware that the Russian government held a meeting on the 2nd of October because they suspected a resident of the Irkutsk oblast had contracted a dangerous infection. On Saturday, WHO asked the Russian Federation for more information, in accordance with the International Health Regulations. On Tuesday, the Russian Federation responded, saying that no case of plague had recently been reported in the Irkutsk oblast, and that they had placed about 200 contacts in quarantine. However, WHO has requested further information on the laboratory tests conducted on the individual who died and the contacts, more detail on what prompted the public health measures, and details about the health status of the contacts. We have also sought verification of media reports of a second employee with pneumonia of undetermined cause. WHO has offered technical support related to plague and lab biosafety and biosecurity. As we don’t yet have the full picture of this event, we are not able to conduct a full risk assessment. Timely, complete and transparent information sharing under the International Health Regulations is essential to clarify conflicting reports and enable an accurate assessment of potential public health risks. Five years ago, the UN Human Rights Council recognized that everyone has the right to a clean, healthy and sustainable environment. Since then, more States have recognized the right nationally, and it has become part of major international decisions on climate change, biodiversity and pollution. Today, more than 85% of States recognize the right in some form. That recognition changed the human rights equation. Clean air and water, a safe and stable climate, healthy ecosystems and biodiversity, and protection from toxic substances are not simply environmental goals. They are part of what every person is entitled to enjoy. That means people have rights, and States have obligations. That means people need access to environmental information and a real say in decisions that affect them. They must also be able to challenge environmental harm and seek a remedy when their rights are violated. States, in turn, have a duty to make these rights effective in practice. Courts around the world are already applying it, with decisions that better protect people and the planet. In in recent advisory opinion on climate change, the International Court of Justice recognized a clean, healthy and sustainable environment as essential for the effective enjoyment of human rights and held that States had a duty to prevent harm to the environment, including the climate system. Today, environmental crises remain among the greatest threats to human rights. The next step is to close the distance between recognition and reality, through concrete measures to ensure everyone can actually enjoy this right.

The Premier of New South Wales, Australia Hon. Christopher (Chris) John Minns, called on the Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs, Mr Shisir Khanal, in Sydney today. Offering condolences over the loss of lives in the recent disaster in Nepal, Premier Minns conveyed the readiness of the Government of New South Wales to assist in Nepal’s recovery efforts. Minister Khanal expressed his sincere gratitude to the people of New South Wales, including the Nepali diaspora, for their sympathy, solidarity and generous support following the devastating floods. He also assured the Premier that locating the missing Australian nationals remains a top priority for the Government of Nepal. The Minister and the Premier exchanged views on opportunities for cooperation in areas including trade, energy, mining, infrastructure, and technical and vocational education and training (TVET), as well as collaboration among higher education institutions in Nepal and New South Wales.

The passing of veteran actor Nana Patekar is an irreparable loss to Indian cinema. Few actors possessed his extraordinary versatility and intensity. He could make audiences laugh with impeccable comic timing, yet in films like Ankush, Prahaar, and Krantiveer he brought a rawness and gravitas that made every character unforgettable. His voice, presence and ability to inhabit completely different worlds made him truly unique. Nana Patekar was not merely an actor; he was an institution in himself. His remarkable contribution to Indian cinema will continue to inspire generations. My heartfelt condolences to his family, friends and countless admirers. May his soul rest in peace. Om Shanti!

The ASEAN Secretariat (ASEC), with support from the Government of the Republic of Korea through the ASEAN-Korea Cooperation Fund (AKCF), strengthened its business continuity capabilities through a three-and-a-half-day training programme on Business Continuity Management Systems (BCMS), aligned with ISO 22301. Conducted in September and October 2026, the programme brought together 14 participants from ASEC’s Community and Corporate Affairs Department to further strengthen organisational preparedness, resilience and continuity of operations. In particular, participants enhanced their knowledge and practical understanding of business continuity management, including how to prepare for, respond to, and recover from potential disruptions including natural disaster and cyber-attack while maintaining critical functions and operations of ASEC. This will equip ASEC to effectively support the work of ASEAN, including the regional cooperation. Upon completion of this training, the participants are eligible to take the certification examination for the PECB ISO 22301 Lead Implementer Credential. This training is part of the project on Learning and Development Programme for Community and Corporate Affairs Department.

On behalf of the Secretary-General of ASEAN, H.E. Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, the Deputy Secretary-General of ASEAN for Community and Corporate Affairs, H.E. Nararya S. The signing marks a key milestone in advancing ASEAN's agenda for quality tourism, strengthening the professionalism and competence of tourism workers and reinforcing the region's commitment to a more skilled, competent, and mobile tourism workforce. 🌊 Capt RS Sawan, Senior Fellow, National Maritime Foundation, participated in Session 5 on Day 2 of the 7th East Asia Summit (EAS) Conference on Maritime Security Cooperation, held in Kochi on 5-6 October 2026. The conference is being organised by the Ministry of External Affairs (@MEAIndia ), Government of India, in collaboration with the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (@dfat ), Government of Australia, the Department of Foreign Affairs (@DFAPHL ), Government of the Philippines, the ASEAN-India Centre, the Research and Information System for Developing Countries (@RIS_NewDelhi ), and the National Maritime Foundation (NMF). European Union member states have approved new rules allowing countries to establish so-called “return hubs” for migrants outside the bloc, as the EU moves to strengthen the enforcement of deportation orders and increase the number of migrants returned from Europe. New Blog: A public-sector investigator can spend hours manually searching Google, public registries, maps, news archives and social media. But when that same investigator asks to use a controlled OSINT tool to search, verify, preserve or analyse information from those same public sources, the answer is often: “No. It is automated.” That is not a legal framework. It is not risk management. The real questions are about authority, necessity, proportionality, data handling, retention, vendor access, verification and oversight. Those questions need answers. Legal teams and leadership should help investigators find the lawful, proportionate and accountable way forward - not stop at an unexplained no. The evidence is public. The obstacle is internal. Finally, this Saturday, the 10th of October, marks #WorldMentalHealthDay This year, our focus is on the lived experience of people with #MentalHealth conditions – especially those who have received institutional care. Often these people are left out of decisions about how mental health systems are designed and reformed. Many are kept in psychiatric hospitals involuntarily for months, years, or even decades, isolating them from the outside world. This week, WHO will launch a practical guide to support countries to shift away from institutionalized care towards person-centred care in communities that respects people’s rights and choices."-@DrTedros

"Also today, WHO and partners are launching a new global roadmap on hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, including #preeclampsia Hypertensive disorders account for about 16% of maternal deaths globally, resulting in 42,000 deaths and more than 500,000 stillbirths and newborn deaths. In many countries, women still lack reliable access to basic blood-pressure measurement and access to testing and essential medicines. Weak referral systems, shortages of trained health workers and limited emergency obstetric services can further delay life-saving care. The new global roadmap aims to address an innovation gap, between the scale of the problem and the availability of medicines to prevent or treat pre-eclampsia. The roadmap aims to accelerate coordinated investment action to ensure that proven interventions and future innovations reach the women and babies who need them most."-@DrTedros

It was a pleasure to meet José Ignacio Paliza @JosePaliza, Minister of the Presidency of the Dominican Republic @MinpreRD, on the margins of our meetings in the country. I expressed my appreciation for the Dominican Republic’s commitment to hosting several @OAS_official and Inter-American System meetings—a strong reflection of its commitment to multilateralism and to strengthening the Inter-American System.

Transnational organized crime is a shared hemispheric challenge that no country can confront alone. At the @CICAD_OEA Group of Experts on Maritime Narcotrafficking in the Dominican Republic, I stressed that confronting these criminal networks requires translating our hemispheric political commitments into direct, practical cooperation among law enforcement, security and justice institutions. This demands building trust and strengthening cooperation at the subregional level, where agencies can exchange intelligence, coordinate operations and develop the relationships needed to act quickly and effectively. We must also examine the legal and institutional barriers that can limit information sharing and operational cooperation. 🇵🇰🤝🇹🇿 Chairman Senate Proposes Resident Tanzanian Mission in Islamabad, Expanded Trade and Parliamentary Cooperation Chairman Senate of Pakistan Syed Yousaf Raza Gilani, during his meeting with Hon. Mussa Azzan Zungu, Speaker of the National Assembly of Tanzania, on the sidelines of the 153rd Assembly of the Inter-Parliamentary Union in Arusha, proposed concrete measures to strengthen Pakistan–Tanzania relations, with a focus on diplomatic presence, trade, technology and parliamentary cooperation. The Chairman Senate called for the establishment of a resident Tanzanian diplomatic mission in Islamabad, noting that a permanent diplomatic presence would strengthen bilateral engagement while facilitating visas, business travel, tourism and greater people-to-people interaction. He also stressed the need to substantially enhance bilateral trade and investment, including stronger linkages between the ports, business communities and chambers of commerce of the two countries. He highlighted the potential for cooperation in information technology, digital innovation, agriculture, education and skills development, and encouraged greater private-sector engagement to translate the goodwill between Pakistan and Tanzania into tangible economic cooperation. As another concrete step, Chairman Senate called for the activation and strengthening of Parliamentary Friendship Groups in both countries, with regular parliamentary exchanges and closer institutional cooperation between the Senate of Pakistan and the National Assembly of Tanzania. Chairman Senate also welcomed greater cooperation in education, including scholarships and academic exchanges for Tanzanian students, and emphasized the importance of building stronger links between the youth and educational institutions of the two countries. He congratulated Hon. Mussa Azzan Zungu, Speaker of the National Assembly of Tanzania, on the successful hosting of the 153rd IPU Assembly in Arusha, and appreciated Tanzania’s role in bringing parliamentarians from across the world together to advance dialogue, parliamentary diplomacy and international cooperation. The 2024 Time Use Survey shows how similar their days can be. Women classified as unpaid family helpers spend 257 minutes a day on employment-related activities, compared with 258 minutes among self-employed women. When domestic chores and caregiving are added, their total working time is also very similar: 10 hours 18 minutes versus 10 hours 7 minutes. An unpaid family helper contributes to a household enterprise without receiving direct remuneration, while a self-employed woman works on her own account. This points to a broader challenge for India's labour market: the issue may not simply be a shortage of work, but also the concentration of labour in activities where long working hours do not necessarily translate into proportionate earnings. وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت ہاؤسنگ، چھوٹے و درمیانے درجے کے کاروبار اور زرعی شعبے کو قرضوں کی فراہمی کے حوالے سے اعلیٰ سطحی جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا. گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ ہاؤسنگ، زراعت اور ایس ایم ای شعبوں کو مالی وسائل کی فراہمی میں حائل رکاوٹیں دور کرکے قرضوں کے نظام کو مزید مؤثر بنایا جائے. چھوٹے و درمیانے درجے کے کاروباری اداروں کو قرضوں کی فراہمی میں سہولت کے لیے ایس ایم ای پورٹل نومبر کے اختتام تک فعال کیا جائے. ایس ایم ای پورٹل کے ذریعے بینکوں کی جانب سے قرضوں کی فراہمی اور لیٹرز آف کریڈٹ (ایل سیز) سمیت کاروباری سہولیات کی تازہ ترین صورتحال کی براہِ راست نگرانی ممکن ہوگی. ایس ایم ایز کی استعداد کار بڑھانے، جدید ٹیکنالوجی کے فروغ، پیداواری صلاحیت میں اضافے اور عالمی ویلیو چین سے منسلک کرنے کے لیے سمیڈا مؤثر اقدامات کرے. اجلاس میں قرضوں کے حوالے سے نیشنل بینک آف پاکستان اور اور فرسٹ ویمن بینک کی کارکردگی کا جائزہ لیا گیا. وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ نیشنل بینک آف پاکستان کی ہاؤسنگ فنانس کے شعبے میں قرضوں کی منظوری کی شرح 76 فیصد ہونا قابلِ تحسین ہے. وزیرِ اعظم نے نیشنل بینک کے نئے تعینات ہونے والے صدر کو ہدایت کی کہ نیشنل بینک کی کارکردگی بڑھانے کیلئے بہترین پروفیشنلز کی خدمات لی جائیں اور مطلوبہ نتائج نہ دینے والے عملے کے خلاف سے بلا خوف محکمانہ کاروائی کی جائے. گفتگو جاری رکھتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ بینکوں کے لیے ہاؤسنگ فنانس کی فراہمی آسان بنانے کے لیے دیگر صوبے پنجاب کی طرز پر اراضی ریکارڈ کی ڈیجیٹلائزیشن تیز کریں. اراضی ریکارڈ کی ڈیجیٹلائزیشن سے بینکوں کے لیے ہاؤسنگ قرضوں کی فراہمی میں آسانی اور شفافیت آئے گی. اجلاس کو ہاوسنگ، زرعی شعبے اور چھوٹے و درمیانے درجے کے کاروباری اداروں کو قرضوں کی فراہمی کے اعداد وشمار پیش کئے گئے. بریفنگ میں بتایا گیا کہ وزیراعظم اپنا گھر اسکیم کے تحت اب تک 426 ارب روپے مالیت کے 71 ہزار 690 قرضوں کی منظوری دی جا چکی ہے. وزیراعظم اپنا گھر اسکیم کے تحت اب تک 13,214 افراد کو 76 ارب روپے کے قرضے جاری کیے جا چکے ہیں. رواں سال 125,000 رہائشی یونٹس کے لیے 700 ارب روپے کے قرضوں کی فراہمی کا ہدف رکھا گیا ہے. زرعی شعبے کے لیے قرضوں کا مجموعی حجم 1,352 ارب روپے ہے، جس سے 34 لاکھ 55 ہزار افراد مستفید ہوئے. جون 2027 تک زرعی قرضوں کا حجم 1,500 ارب روپے اور مستفید ہونے والوں کی تعداد 45 لاکھ کا ہدف مقرر ہے. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ زرعی شعبے کی مالی وسائل تک رسائی بڑھا کر کسانوں کی پیداواری صلاحیت اور معاشی سرگرمیوں کو فروغ دیا جائے گا. ایس ایم ای شعبے کے 3 لاکھ 50 ہزار کاروباری افراد کو 1,137 ارب روپے کے قرضے فراہم کیے جا چکے ہیں. جون 2027 تک ایس ایم ای شعبے کے قرضوں کا حجم 1,500 ارب روپے اور قرض حاصل کرنے والے کاروباری اداروں کی تعداد 5 لاکھ 65 ہزار کا ہدف مقرر ہے. ایس ایم ایز کو مالی وسائل تک آسان رسائی، جدید ٹیکنالوجی میں سرمایہ کاری اور عالمی منڈیوں میں مسابقت کے قابل بنانے کے لیے اقدامات جاری ہیں. ایس ایم ایز کے لیے نظرثانی شدہ ضوابط اور ہاؤسنگ فنانس کے طریقہ کار کو مزید آسان اور مؤثر بنانے کےلئے اقدامات لئے جارہے ہیں. قرضوں کی فراہمی میں مشترکہ رسک شیئرنگ، سپلائی چین فنانسنگ کے فروغ ، مستند ڈیٹا شیئرنگ اور دیگر جاری اقدامات پر بریفنگ دی گئی. بریفنگ میں مزید بتایا گیا کہ چھوٹے قرضوں کے حصول کے لیے صارفین کو بینک برانچوں کے چکر لگانے سے نجات دلانے کے لیے ڈیجیٹل نظام کو فروغ دیا جارہا ہے. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء رانا تنویر حسین، احد خان چیمہ، محمد اورنگزیب، ریاض حسین پیرزادہ، عطا اللہ تارڑ، وزیراعظم کے مشیر ہارون اختر، گورنر اسٹیٹ بینک جمیل احمد اور دیگر اعلیٰ سرکاری حکام نے شرکت کی۔

President Droupadi Murmu visited the Atal Tunnel, Rohtang, Himachal Pradesh. The strategically significant Atal Tunnel which connects Manali to the Lahaul-Spiti valley throughout the year was inaugurated in 2020 by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi. The President said that the Atal Tunnel is an engineering marvel of global standards, constructed with exemplary dedication by the Border Roads Organisation. This iconic infrastructure stands as a testament to India’s technological prowess, determination and commitment to ensuring seamless connectivity in the most challenging terrains.

پنجمین نمایشگاه عمومی و بین‌المللی امام ابوحنیفه (رح) امروز در کابل افتتاح شد و مقام‌های امارت اسلامی بر جذب سرمایه‌گذاری، تقویت تولیدات داخلی و استفاده از ظرفیت‌های اقتصادی افغانستان تأکید کردند. در این نمایشگاه ۳۲۳ شرکت داخلی و خارجی با حدود ۶۰۰ غرفه حضور دارند و ۵۵۰ مهمان خارجی نیز شرکت کرده‌اند. نورالدین عزیزی، وزیر صنعت و تجارت، از سکتور خصوصی خواست در افغانستان سرمایه‌گذاری کند و گفت زنجیره‌های تولیدی کشور باید در داخل تقویت شود. محسن زنگنه، رئیس کمیسیون ویژۀ حمایت از تولید مجلس شورای اسلامی ایران نیز گفت که افغانستان دارای ظرفیت‌های مختلف در بخش‌های ترانزیت، معادن و نیروی انسانی است و باید این کشور به‌عنوان یک فرصت سرمایه‌گذاری دیده شود، نه کشور مصرف‌کننده. او گفت ایران آماده است مانند گذشته در بخش تجارت در کنار افغانستان باشد. #افغانستان #نمایشگاه_امام_ابوحنیفه #سرمایه‌گذاری #Afghanistan #ImamAbuHanifaExhibition #Investment

معاونیت اقتصادی ریاست‌الوزرا می‌گوید که کمیسیون تدارکات ۱۶ پروژه به ارزش بیش از هفت میلیارد افغانی را منظور کرده و تعدیلات لازم را در نُه پروژۀ دیگر نیز به تصویب رسانده است. بر بنیاد معلومات این معاونیت در میان این پروژه‌ها، کانکریت‌ریزی پارکینگ گمرک مرزی اسلام‌قلعه، تمدید پایپ آب از بند قرغه به باغ تحقیقاتی بادام‌باغ کابل، ساخت ۱۱ کیلومتر سرک در ولسوالی محمدآغۀ لوگر و بازسازی ۷۱ کیلومتر سرک میان بروغیل و بزای گنبد در ولسوالی واخان بدخشان شامل است. همچنان، منبع می‌افزاید که ساخت یک ترمینل و شماری از سرک‌ها در کابل، اعمار شفاخانه‌های عمومی در ولسوالی‌های کهمرد بامیان، لولاش فاریاب و ارگون پکتیکا و نیز ساخت شفاخانۀ ۳۵۰ بستری بست در هلمند، از دیگر پروژه‌های شامل در این فهرست است.

وزیراعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت پاکستان ریلوے میں اصلاحات پر جائزہ اجلاس اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا۔ اجلاس میں وزیراعظم نے مین لائن ون (ML-1) کی اپ گریڈیشن پر تیزی سے کام کرنے اور پاکستان ریلوے میں کارپوریٹ طرز پر اصلاحات کی ہدایت کردی. وزیراعظم نے پاکستان ریلوے کی قبضہ شدہ زمینوں کی نشاندہی اور ان کی واگزاری کے حوالے سے چیئرمین نیب کی سربراہی میں نیب اور وزارتِ ریلوے کی ٹیموں کی کاوشوں کو سراہا۔ اجلاس سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وزیرِ اعظم نے کہا کہ پاکستان ریلوے کی ترقی، مسافروں کو بہتر سفری سہولیات کی فراہمی اور فریٹ ٹرانسپورٹ میں اضافے کے لیے مین لائن ون کی جدت کلیدی اہمیت کی حامل ہے. ریلوے کی اربوں روپے مالیت کی نشاندہی شدہ اراضی کو بروئے کار لاتے ہوئے کمرشل بنیادوں پر ایم ایل ون کی تعمیر عمل میں لائی جائے. ریلوے کی املاک میں موجود حقیقی تجارتی صلاحیت کو بروئے کار لانے کی ضرورت ہے. وزیرِ اعظم نے مزید کہا کہ ریلوے کی قیمتی اراضی کو کمرشل مقاصد کے لیے مؤثر انداز میں استعمال کرکے ملکی معیشت اور ریلوے کی ترقی میں کردار ادا کیا جائے. ریلوے کو مضبوط اور معاشی طور پر خود کفیل بنانے کے لیے کارپوریٹ طرز پر اصلاحات حکومت کی ترجیحات میں شامل ہیں. ریلوے کو منافع بخش بنانے اور اس کے آپریشنز کو بہتر کرنے کے لیے وزیرِ ریلوے بھرپور محنت کر رہے ہیں. وزیراعظم نے ریلوے کی اراضی پر مختلف کمرشل منصوبوں کے ذریعے بینکوں کی فنڈنگ حاصل کرکے ایم ایل ون کی تعمیر کے لیے بروئے کار لانے کی منظوری دی۔ وزیراعظم نے ریلوے کی اراضی کی حقیقی تجارتی استعداد کو سامنے رکھتے ہوئے آئندہ دو ہفتوں میں جامع منصوبہ پیش کرنے کی ہدایت کی۔ اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ 1726 کلومیٹر طویل ایم ایل ون کی اپ گریڈیشن کو چار بڑے حصوں میں تقسیم کیا گیا ہے، جن میں کراچی-روہڑی، روہڑی-ملتان، ملتان-لاہور اور لاہور-پشاور کے سیکشن شامل ہیں. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ کراچی-روہڑی سیکشن کی اپ گریڈیشن کے لیے بین الاقوامی فنانسنگ سے استفادہ کیا جا رہا ہے جبکہ ایم ایل ون کے دیگر سیکشنز کے لیے مقامی وسائل سے فنڈنگ کا منصوبہ بنایا جا رہا ہے۔ اجلاس کو ایم ایل ون منصوبے کی تعمیر کے مختلف مراحل، کراچی-روہڑی سیکشن پر پیش رفت اور ریلوے کی ملکیتی اراضی کے حوالے سے بریفنگ دی گئی۔ وزیراعظم نے ہدایت کی کہ ریلوے کی واگزار کرائی گئی اراضی کو کمرشل بنیادوں پر بروئے کار لانے اور ایم ایل ون کی تعمیر کے لیے بینکوں کی فنڈنگ حاصل کرنے کے حوالے سے جامع لائحہ عمل دو ہفتوں میں پیش کیا جائے۔ اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء احسن اقبال، احد خان چیمہ، محمد اورنگزیب، حنیف عباسی، وزیر مملکت بلال اظہر کیانی، گورنر اسٹیٹ بینک جمیل احمد، چیئرمین نیب لیفٹینینٹ جنرل (ر) نذیر احمد بٹ اور متعلقہ اعلیٰ حکام نے شرکت کی۔
